title: Wanting to play with a band; friends discourage the xylophone
summary: As a vaudeville single he longed to play in a band, while hometown friends said no one could use that instrument in a band.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone
